flags.title: MEDICAID NOT EXPANDED — Standard Coverage Gap
flags.summary: Alabama has not expanded Medicaid. Adults 19-64 without categorical eligibility have NO coverage pathway. Route to FQHCs, UAB charity care, USA Health.

flags.title: Alabama Black Belt — Most Underserved Region in Registry
flags.summary: Black Belt counties (Dallas, Perry, Hale, Greene, Sumter, Marengo, Choctaw, Wilcox, Lowndes, Bullock, Macon) have 25-40% poverty. Phone-only contact often the only viable option.

flags.title: Alabama UI — $275/Week Max, Tied Lowest in Registry, 12-Day Appeal
flags.summary: Alabama UI maximum $275/week — tied lowest. Duration: 14-20 weeks. Appeal deadline: 12 days from mailing — contact legal aid within 6 days.

flags.title: Alabama TANF — $215/Month, Near Lowest, 60-Month Limit
flags.summary: Alabama TANF $215/month for family of 3. 60-month federal lifetime limit. Not survivable alone — pair with every available resource.

flags.title: Poarch Band of Creek Indians — Only Federally Recognized Tribe in AL
flags.summary: Poarch Band is the only federally recognized tribe in Alabama. Wind Creek Casino revenue funds tribal services. ICWA applies for child welfare.

flags.title: Alabama Civil Rights — ACRC 180-Day SOL, No State LGBTQ+ Protection
flags.summary: ACRC has 180-day SOL. No state LGBTQ+ protection — EEOC federal charge only. File EEOC and ACRC simultaneously.

flags.title: Birmingham / Huntsville Dual Profile
flags.summary: Birmingham: largest city, healthcare disparities, UAB safety net. Huntsville: aerospace/defense hub, housing cost pressure. Different routing required.

flags.title: Alabama Eviction — 7-Day Notice, Fast Small Claims Timeline
flags.summary: ARLTA applies only in adopted jurisdictions. 7-day pay or quit notice. Hearing within 6 days. Contact legal aid same day.

flags.title: Involuntary Hold: Alabama Involuntary Commitment
flags.message: AL involuntary psychiatric hold law: Alabama Involuntary Commitment. Statutory authority: Ala. Code § 22-52-10. Maximum initial hold duration: 5 days. Legal standard: danger to self/others or gravely disabled. A hearing must be held before the hold can be extended. The person has the right to counsel at the hearing.
action_items: Verify hold did not exceed 5 days without court order
Confirm hearing was held within statutory timeframe
Check that patient rights notice was provided at admission
Request complete hold documentation from facility

flags.title: Psychiatric Patient Rights
flags.message: Psychiatric patients in AL retain fundamental rights during hospitalization: right to communicate with persons outside the facility, right to receive and send mail, right to access legal counsel, right to refuse treatment (with limited exceptions), right to informed consent, right to access medical records, and right to file grievances. These rights cannot be restricted as a condition of treatment.
action_items: Verify patient rights notice was provided and signed
Check whether any rights were restricted and if proper procedures were followed
Confirm access to legal counsel was not impeded

flags.title: Federal Restraint & Seclusion Limits
flags.message: Federal law (42 CFR § 482.13) sets strict limits on restraint and seclusion in AL: physician order required within 1 hour, face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour, continuous monitoring required, maximum 4 hours per order for adults (2 hours for ages 9-17, 1 hour for under 9), and restraint may only be used to protect the patient from harm — never as punishment, convenience, or retaliation.
action_items: Request restraint/seclusion logs for all episodes
Verify physician order was obtained within 1 hour
Check that face-to-face evaluation occurred within 1 hour
Verify restraint was not used as punishment or convenience
Check for injuries during restraint episodes
legal_references: CMS State Operations Manual Appendix A

flags.title: Involuntary Psychiatric Hold Statute
flags.message: This state has specific statutes governing involuntary psychiatric holds. Know the time limits, hearing rights, and appeal procedures before they expire.

flags.title: Mental Health Patient Bill of Rights
flags.message: This state has a Patient Bill of Rights for mental health facilities. Facilities must inform patients of these rights upon admission.
flags.statute: Alabama Mental Health Patient Rights Act

flags.title: Discharge Planning Requirements
flags.message: This state requires facilities to create discharge plans with follow-up appointments, medication management, and community resource referrals.
flags.statute: Alabama Mental Health Discharge Planning Standards
